items.rationale: Clauses 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f) exclude translation costs even when the police report is required for cover.
Clauses 7.1.8(e)–(f) exclude the provider's working materials and disbursements associated with the translation.

The watch was taken in a covered robbery under 2.3.1–2.3.2. Its like-for-like value under 7.1.9 is expected to exceed the €2,500 unscheduled valuables cap; allocating the single €150 deductible pro rata gives €2,500 − €125 = €2,375.

The roughly €900 taken is capped at €500 under 2.3.2 and 4.2.3. The combined €3,000 covered loss is below the €5,000 away-from-home cap; this line's pro rata share of the single €150 deductible is €25, leaving €475.
The sunglasses were mislaid later, not taken in the robbery, so 2.3.4(a) and 7.1.5 exclude them.
Clauses 5.2.3 and 7.1.8(b) exclude shipping for replacement property or claim documents, even when billed alongside covered compensation.
